metadata_input_policy: Historical fingerprints; only record descriptions and north camera direction are consumed and embedded here. Frontend QA resealing does not alter those fields.
method: One native render of both detailed construction layers, shared world-coordinate materials, source-road union and one camera; never a montage of the independent images
limitations: Dimensions and unseen details are estimated. Background buildings are not part of the 19 selectable parts. User visual acceptance remains pending.

landscape_revision.source_ground_color_method: bounded red-minus-green dryness field from fixed satellite RGB, maximum mix 0.55; illustrative pigment colours
landscape_revision.tree_shape_note: All crown centres inherited; heights, leaf transmission and crown species appearance remain estimated

ground_revision.source: Fixed model/campus/references/satellite.jpg, native pixels = recorded display pixels × 2; compare campus-aerial.jpg for material family.
ground_revision.limitations: Ground classification interpreted from fixed imagery, not surveyed. Bay sizes, marking spacing, joint sizes and planted strip edges are estimated; no parking capacity or pedestrian navigation network is asserted.

architecture_revision.basis: Fixed campus-aerial.jpg: pale dining block with wide central window bands and grouped narrow end lights; red academic block with continuous masonry piers and glazed east entrance. Existing N32/N33 source-aligned roof bands retained.
architecture_revision.method: In-memory facade replacement before shared scene construction; all roof faces, heights, camera and source footprints retained.

visual_review.method: Viewed fixed overhead source crop, two native previews, final native joined render, desktop overview and selected N34 mobile screenshot. No AI image generation.
findings: Source north parking restored as a continuous mineral lot with illustrative bay lines and access aisles.
Pale academic inner courtyard classified as hardstanding; previous inferred lawn and courtyard hedge display superseded.
Source academic planting strips and subtle margins within existing paving distinguish pedestrian edges without adding routes.
visual_review.remaining: User acceptance of stage 2 pending; campus-wide extension and map presentation are queued stages 3–4. Whole-campus case-level final acceptance remains pending.

frontend_validation.method: Playwright CLI; all 19 unique searches and actual pointer roof clicks with labels hidden on both viewports; independent NumPy roof/ground projection checks.
frontend_validation.limitations: No physical touchscreen test; frontend unchanged, previous failure/retry and 320px checks were not rerun for this image-only iteration.
frontend_validation.current_source_note: Full-campus ground-fit support added after this sample QA; sample image, geometry and construction recipe unchanged. Prior QA remains historical.

visual_review.method: Viewed native joined render, original aerial reference, desktop overview and selected N31 mobile screenshot. No AI image generation.
findings: N31 central glass ribbons and grouped end lights distinguish it from the dormitory window grids.
N31 shallow glazed entrance; N34/N35 continuous masonry piers retain existing glazed east entrance and roof pavilions.
visual_review.remaining: User acceptance of stage 1 pending; ground detail, campus-wide extension and map presentation are queued stages 2–4. Whole-campus case-level final acceptance remains pending.

runtime_requirements.cache_policy: Fresh empty candidate cache is supported. Only candidate PNG and metadata are regenerated; no source scene is saved.

metadata_integrity_note: This metadata binds its image, fixed inputs, generator and frontend. Its own hash is not embedded. Independent map metadata is unchanged.
